p: Satan stood up against Israel: He tempted David, in setting before his eyes his excellency and glory, his power and victories, see 2Sa 24:1.
Beersheba even to Dan: That is, from south to north.
trespass to Israel: It was a thing indifferent and usual to number the people, but because he did it for ambitious reasons, as though his strength stood in his people, God punished him.
a thousand thousand and an hundred: Joab partly for grief and partly through negligence gathered not the whole sum as it is here declared.

four hundred threescore and ten thousand: In Samuel 30,000 more are mentioned, which was either by joining to them some of the Benjamites who were mixed with Judah, or as the Hebrews write, here the chief and princes are left out.
repented him of the evil: When God draws back his plagues, he seems to repent, read Ge 6:6.
thy people: Thus he both shows a true repentance and a fatherly care toward his people, who desire God to spare them, and to punish him and his.
hid themselves: If man hides himself at the sight of an angel who is a creature, how much more as a sinner able to appear before the face of God?
altar therein unto the LORD: This he did by the command of God, 1Ch 21:18, or else it would have been abominable, unless he had either God's word, or revelation.
price: That is, as much as it is worth: for having enough of his own, and yet to have taken of another man's goods to offer to the Lord would had been theft and not acceptable to God.
six hundred shekels of gold by: Read 2Sa 24:24.

answered him from heaven by fire: God declared that he heard his request, in that he sent down fire from heaven for they could use no fire in sacrifice but that which was reserved still upon the altar, Le 6:13 and came down from heaven, Le 9:24 as appeared by the punishment of Nadab and Abihu, Le 10:1.
